nom: Shiseido Benefiance Dark Spot and Wrinkle Smoothing Serum

segments.combination: Reviewers with combination or combination-sensitive skin describe the texture as lightweight and non-greasy, reporting smoother texture, subtle fading of acne scars and reduced dark spots on the cheeks with regular use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including sun-damaged skin, describe the serum as deeply hydrating and say it helped even out tone and texture.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin report no irritation, redness or stinging alongside instant hydration; most say dark-spot fading is slower to appear than the hydration benefit.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s dealing with hyperpigmentation and fine lines report smoother, firmer-looking skin and fading dark spots with consistent use, describing gradual rather than overnight results.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal-combination skin and hyperpigmentation reports the serum feels bouncy and hydrated after about a week of use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report fine lines and wrinkles, especially around the mouth, forehead and smile lines, look smoother and less prominent with regular use, though several note this is a gradual effect rather than an immediate change.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently report instant hydration and a plumper, more comfortable feel from the first uses, regardless of how quickly they see results on dark spots or wrinkles.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with reactive skin reports no redness or stinging from the serum.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers report their dark spots, including post-acne and sun-related hyperpigmentation, fade and look lighter or more balanced after two or more weeks of consistent use; several others say they have not yet noticed a significant change in dark spots after one to two weeks and expect longer use is needed.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin or active breakouts report the serum helped fade post-acne marks and diminish some stubborn spots without causing new breakouts or irritation.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under moisturizer and makeup without pilling
Fragrance may be too strong for scent-sensitive users

extraits.titre: I've changed from the serum to the cream
extraits.texte: It promised the removal of dark spot. We'll my skin feels great, but the dark spots are still there.

I received this complimentary from Shisedo. Their Benefiance Dark Spot and Wrinkle Smoothing Serum is fancy. The bottle feels ceramic and is heavy. The product is thin, lightweight, and milky. It absorbs right away. I have sensitive skin, and it didn't irritate me. I haven't noticed my dark spots fading yet, but I do see the instant hydration. I'm gonna keep this in my skincare rotation.

extraits.titre: The texture is Amazing! Feathery and smooth!
extraits.texte: I am in my early forties, and my skin shows visible signs of aging. I noticed hyperpigmentation and appearance of fine lines on my facial skin and, I wanted to try a formulation that helps with aging concerns. I started using the Dark Spot and Wrinkle Smoothing Serum by Shiseido in combination with their facial foaming cleanser. I love the feathery texture and calming scent. It absorbs instantly and has a gentle feel on my skin. After consistent use, my skin feels visibly firmer .Over all skin tone looks even and smooth. I appreciate how gently and effectively the formulation works for my skin type. My skin looks and feels healthier and youthful! The serum was gifted by Shiseido and I am happy to present my honest review!

A lovely serum. It's on the more lightweight side, and very easily absorbed. It has a bright sweet/herbal fragrance that fades quickly but I do like it. I am in my early 30s with dry skin and like how this feels, hydrating and soft without being heavy. Time will tell on the wrinkles claims - I have a few fine lines on my forehead that feel slightly plumped with this in my routine but looking for long lasting effects. Gifted by Shiseido

Gifted by Shiseido. This serum is lightweight, silky, and absorbs quickly which makes it easy to layer morning or night. After a couple weeks of use, my skin looks more even and my complexion appeared brighter and smoother. It also kept my face hydrated throughout the day. My skin can be reactive, and this serum gave me no redness or stinging. Love that it's gentle enough for daily use!

I have only used Shiseido products once, and so I wasn't sure how this serum would be. I have dark spots and uneven skin texture, so I was definitely excited to try this! The texture is light and absorbs in great. I love that it's for acne prone skin, as I have some active breakouts. I can't wait to see the long-term results! Gifted by Shiseido.
